scope: International adult men's classical games only; 2025 WXF main championship, 60 minutes + 30 seconds per move. Women's, rapid/open rapid and youth sections are excluded from the bundled collection.
method: Conservative exact source-name matching, including expired sanctions and criticism notices. No claim of universal absence of misconduct is made.
